ApplicationPlan.description: A generic Node application and its configuration command. All artifact paths are relative to the supplied built root.

callbackPath.description: Exact loopback callback path registered with the run issuer.

checker.description: Built configuration checker, invoked with the generated config path.

client.description: Confidential browser client identifier admitted by the selected product profiles.

configEnvironment.description: Environment variable naming the generated host configuration for the child.

configSchema.description: Closed run-input schema name understood by the declared configuration command.

deployment.description: Configuration source file, relative to the development project.

entry.description: Built application entry, relative to the supplied artifact root.

healthPath.description: Local readiness path served by the application.

prepare.description: Built configuration command, invoked with --deployment, --run and --out.

prepareVersion.description: Exact one-line response of the configuration command's --version flag.

Bindings.description: Run-local connections between BReg and Casework. Configuring either one requires both products, with BReg listed before Casework.

bregReviewAuthority.description: Connects BReg to Casework as a review authority. BReg authenticates to Casework as a machine identity.

caseworkContextProvider.description: Connects Casework to BReg as a context provider. Casework authenticates to BReg as a machine identity.

BregReviewAuthority.description: A BReg review authority that the run connects to Casework.

id.description: Local identifier of the review authority.

identity.description: Name of the test person, in `people`, whose Casework grant BReg uses to authenticate. That grant needs at least one scope.

producer.description: Local identifier of the review producer.

Capture.description: A value remembered from a response, selected by `type`.

oneOf.description: Remember the value at a JSON pointer in the response body.

pointer.description: JSON pointer into the response body: empty for the whole body, otherwise starting with `/`.

oneOf.description: Remember a value from the one array item that matches a condition. The step fails if no item or more than one item matches.

find.description: JSON pointer to the array in the response body to search.

pointer.description: JSON pointer, relative to the matching item, of the value to remember.

where.description: The condition an item must meet.

oneOf.description: Remember the value at a JSON pointer, optionally reading one query parameter from a URL found there.

pointer.description: JSON pointer into the response body: empty for the whole body, otherwise starting with `/`.

query.description: Name of a query parameter. When set, the value at the pointer must be a URL or relative reference, and the parameter's value is remembered instead. At most 256 characters without whitespace or control characters.

CapturedHeader.description: The entity tag, usable as an `If-Match` value in a later step.

CaseworkContextProvider.description: A Casework context provider that the run connects to BReg.

action.description: Local identifier of the BReg action that the provider pairs with.

id.description: Local identifier of the context provider.

identity.description: Name of the test person, in `people`, whose BReg grant Casework uses to authenticate. That grant needs at least one scope.

Check.description: An assertion about one value in the response body. Set exactly one of `equals`, `length` or `contains`.

contains.description: The array at the pointer must hold this item, the string must contain this text, or the object must have this key. String values may contain `{{name}}` references to earlier captures.

equals.description: The value at the pointer must equal this. String values may contain `{{name}}` references to earlier captures.

length.description: The array, object or string at the pointer must have this many items, entries or characters, at most 1048576.

pointer.description: JSON pointer to the value to test: empty for the whole body, otherwise starting with `/`.

DerivedId.description: A dotted development journey step identifier whose segments are local identifiers.

DisplayText.description: Human-readable display text. Bidirectional embedding, override, and isolate controls, byte-order marks, line and paragraph separators, and Unicode noncharacters are refused; multilingual joiners and direction marks remain valid.

Expected.description: The conditions a response must meet.

checks.description: Further assertions about the response body, at most 32. Each one tests a single JSON pointer.

code.description: Problem code the error response must carry, 1 to 256 characters without whitespace or control characters. It may contain `{{name}}` references to earlier captures.

json.description: Exact values the response body must hold, keyed by JSON pointer (empty for the whole body, otherwise starting with `/`). String values may contain `{{name}}` references to earlier captures.
json.x-registry-passthrough: Expected values are compared with the product response at the named JSON pointers.

status.description: Accepted HTTP status: one status, or a list of 1 to 16 distinct statuses, each from 200 to 599.

anyOf.description: A single accepted status from 200 to 599.
Several accepted statuses, each from 200 to 599; the response may carry any one of them.

ExpectedStatus.description: One accepted HTTP status or a list of them.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

FindWhere.description: The condition a `find` capture uses to pick an array item.

equals.description: The value an item must hold at the pointer to match. String values may contain `{{name}}` references to earlier captures.

pointer.description: JSON pointer, relative to each array item, of the value to compare.

Grant.description: The authority a test person holds in one product.

claims.description: Additional token claims, keyed by claim name. Names must not be reserved token claims such as `iss`, `aud`, `sub`, `scope` or any `registry_grant_` claim.
claims.x-registry-passthrough: Claim values are written into the development token as given.

profile.description: Local identifier of the product profile this grant uses.

scopes.description: Distinct scopes written into the token, at most 32, each 1 to 256 characters without whitespace or control characters.

Journey.description: An ordered list of requests the run sends and checks.

steps.description: The steps, run in order. Include 1 to 32 with distinct identifiers. A step may refer to captures from earlier steps only.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

Poll.description: How long and how often to repeat a GET request. The wait divided by the interval, rounded up, must be below 250 attempts.

maximumWaitMilliseconds.description: Longest total wait in milliseconds, from 1 to 60000.

pollIntervalMilliseconds.description: Pause between attempts in milliseconds, from 50 to 5000 and not above the maximum wait.

Product.description: A product the development run can start.

ProductPlan.description: One product to start and where its project lives.

audience.description: Token audience this product accepts: 1 to 256 characters without whitespace or control characters, distinct from the other products' audiences.

project.description: Relative path from the plan's directory to the product project, or `.` for the plan's own directory. It must contain registry.yaml for BReg or casework.yaml for Casework.

RawBody.description: A request body sent as given, without JSON encoding.

base64.description: The body as standard base64, at most 1 MiB once decoded.

contentType.description: HTTP media type for the Content-Type header, containing a slash, 1 to 256 ASCII characters.

Step.description: One HTTP request, what to expect back, and what to remember from the response.

as.description: The test person who sends the request. The person needs a grant for this step's product.

body.description: JSON request body, at most 1 MiB once encoded. String values may contain `{{name}}` references to earlier captures. Do not combine with `raw`.

capture.description: Values to remember from the response, keyed by a capture name. Later steps refer to a capture as `{{name}}` in paths, headers, bodies and expectations. Names are unique across the journey.

expect.description: What the response must look like for the step to pass.

headers.description: Extra request headers, keyed by header name. Only `If-Match`, `Idempotency-Key` and `Registry-Source-Profile` are supported. Values may contain `{{name}}` references to earlier captures.

id.description: Unique step identifier: a local identifier, or a dotted sequence of local identifiers, at most 64 characters.

path.description: Request path, starting with `/v1/`, at most 2048 characters, without whitespace, control characters, backslashes or fragments. It may contain `{{name}}` references to earlier captures.

poll.description: Repeat a GET request until it passes or the wait runs out. Allowed only for GET.

product.description: The product that receives the request.

raw.description: Non-JSON request body. Allowed only for methods other than GET. Do not combine with `body`.

TestPerson.description: A named test identity that signs in to the started products.

caseworkContext.description: Forward the same authority to both products. Both grants must declare the same scopes and additional claims.

client.description: Client identifier of this person's tokens: 1 to 256 characters without whitespace or control characters.

displayName.description: Name shown in the synthetic browser sign-in picker; it grants no authority.

grants.description: The authority this person holds in each product, keyed by `breg` or `casework`. Give at least one grant, only for products listed in `products`.

subject.description: Subject claim of this person's tokens: 1 to 256 characters without whitespace or control characters.

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host preserved as written, no user information, and no backslash, whitespace or control character. DNS case and equivalent IPv6 literals are permitted.

description: The development plan: the products to start, the test people who call them, and the journey to run.

apiVersion.description: The format and version this file is written in.

application.description: A built local application this run prepares, starts, checks and stops. Its artifact root is supplied to `rstack dev start`.

bindings.description: Run-local connections between BReg and Casework. Leave empty when the products do not call each other.

issuer.description: HTTPS URL for an existing issuer, or `run` when a declared application uses this run's loopback browser issuer.

journey.description: The ordered sequence of HTTP requests the run sends to the started products.

kind.description: The kind of document this file is.

people.description: The test people, keyed by a lowercase local identifier. Define 1 to 32, and give at least one grant to every started product.

products.description: The products to start, each with its project directory and token audience. List each product at most once.

schemaTestPeople.description: Chooses the test person for a BReg fixture step in tests/journeys.yaml, keyed by journey identifier and then step identifier. Needed only when several people could run the step; every named person needs a BReg grant.

title: Registry Stack project development plan
